verdict.rationale: Bolt supports prompt-driven iteration with some safeguards: Plan Mode lets you discuss changes without touching code, GitHub sync keeps a full change history, and one user reports building apps with 99% of edits via prompts by reverting and re-prompting. However, hands-on reports concretely contradict the 'without breaking' promise. One user describes the AI making unauthorized changes that removed a security layer and broke payment functionality, and another describes a doom loop where each fix resurrected a previous break. Missing for 10: any documented regression protection or change scoping for follow-up prompts, a documented in-product revert/checkpoint feature, and consistent independent evidence that iterations preserve working functionality.
